description: Read the full text of one Italian administrative-court ruling found with search_rulings: pass its `case_key`, `file` and `schema` as returned there. Returns the court, ECLI where present, and the ruling text (truncated at max_chars). Source: Giustizia Amministrativa.

max_chars.description: Characters of text to return (1000-60000, default 15000)

schema.description: Court code from search_rulings, e.g. "tar_rm" or "cds"

name: get_ruling
title: Get Ruling
